_notes.charger_kw: Energy reaching the pack, NOT the figure the plug reports. On 120V L1 these differ by about 30%. Derive it from SOC gain over a long session in data/battery_status.csv rather than from charging_sessions.csv power columns, which are wall-side.
_notes.trip_soc_pct: Share of the pack the one-way trip consumes. Measure it from a past run of the same route: departure SOC minus arrival SOC.
_notes.planned_driving: Energy for each day between now and departure. Measure typical days from trips.csv rather than guessing; days with a recurring errand often run noticeably higher than the weekday median.
